title: Implement roles and responsibilities
reason: The roles are recorded and enforced: the owner of the security system and of every risk, supplier and personal data store is Daniel (config/model/systems/security.json and each record's owner); nobody changes production by hand (D-054), which the production guard refuses; a unit's files change only with its owner's approval, which commit-check refuses otherwise (STD-train-ownership-refusals); the security records and their owner were set by D-321; and every session, the only developer, loads the same rules (AGENTS.md) and judges every request against them (D-294), which is its training (PO.2.2).
